papers.title: Reinforcement Learning from Rich Feedback with Distributional DAgger
papers.evidence: Loss is forward cross-entropy H×(π_T, π_θ) on student-sampled states, equivalent to forward KL D_KL(π_T || π_θ) up to constant.
papers.notes: REINFORCE future-credit term aids gradient estimation but the objective minimized is forward CE to teacher.

papers.title: Self-Evaluation Is Already There: Eliciting Latent Judge Calibration in Base LLMs with Minimal Data
papers.evidence: Masked cross-entropy on self-eval score tokens (NLL on teacher-judge labels) plus GRPO RL with composite reward, no explicit KL(teacher||student) term.
papers.notes: Distillation is NLL on judge scores not KL divergence; RL reward is custom calibration+quality, not standard teacher KL.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: r = w_q * (1/3 * sum(j_a/9)) + w_c * (1 - MAE(s,j)/9)^gamma for RL; cross-entropy on self-eval score tokens only for distillation

papers.title: Rethinking Continual Experience Internalization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
papers.evidence: L_on(θ) = E_{H~πθ} Σ_t D_KL(q_t ∥ p_t) is reverse KL with student q first, on student-generated trajectories.
papers.notes: Paper uses both FKL (off-policy) and RKL (on-policy); on-policy method is the novel contribution driving self-evolution.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L_off(θ) = E_{H~πT} Σ_t D_KL(p_t ∥ q_t); L_on(θ) = E_{H~πθ} Σ_t D_KL(q_t ∥ p_t)

papers.title: DuDi: Dual-Signal Distillation with Cross-Lingual Verbalizer
papers.evidence: Loss combines token-level KD (teacher logits, forward KL) with SPIN sequence-level objective (preference/RL-like signal). Both are load-bearing.
papers.notes: SPIN is a self-play preference objective; KD terms are forward KL on teacher logits. Both contribute to DuDi.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L_DuDi = α E[L_SPIN(x,y,y';π_θ,π_Ref)] + (1-λ) E[L_Off-KD(x,y;π_θ,π_θT)] + λ E[L_On-KD(x,ỹ,z;π_θ,π_θT)]

papers.title: Self-Distilled Policy Gradient
papers.evidence: L_SDPG combines L_out (REINFORCE with verifier rewards) and L+_OPD (reverse-KL self-distillation from privileged teacher), both load-bearing.
papers.notes: Self-distillation uses reverse KL; RL uses binary verifier rewards with group-relative advantages.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L_SDPG = L_out + β(k) L+_OPD + α L_K(π_θ, π_ref)

papers.title: Physics-Guided Policy Optimization with Self-Distillation
papers.evidence: Loss is D_KL(π_θ(·|x,y_{<t}) || stopgrad(π_θ(·|x,f,y_{<t}))), student in first argument = reverse KL direction.
papers.notes: Self-distillation: feedback-conditioned self acts as teacher. Physics-guided multiplier modulates gradient but KL direction is RKL.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L = D_KL(π_θ(·|x,y_{<t}) || stopgrad(π_θ(·|x,f,y_{<t})))

papers.title: World Models Meet Language Models: On the Complementarity of Concrete and Abstract Reasoning
papers.evidence: L_disc = D_KL(sg[q_t^*] || π_θ) is forward KL with stopped-gradient teacher q_t* as first argument.
papers.notes: Advantage-weighted distillation with privileged evaluator scores resembles KL+RL, but KL(teacher||student) dominates formulation.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L = L_SFT + L_disc + L_text + λ_call * E[N_sim], where L_disc = D_KL(sg[q_t^*] || π_θ) and L_text = -Σ sg[w_{t,k}] log π_θ(a_k)

papers.title: When Should the Teacher Move? Temporal Coupling and Stability in Self On-Policy Distillation
papers.evidence: L_t = -E[r(x)] + lambda * KL(pi_theta || pi_phi) combines RL reward with KL distillation to self-teacher.
papers.notes: Self-distillation: teacher is frozen student copy. KL direction is reverse (student first argument).
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L_t = -E_{x~pi_theta}[r(x)] + lambda * KL(pi_theta || pi_phi)

papers.title: Constitutional On-Policy Safe Distillation
papers.evidence: Token-level reverse-KL reward r(i,t)=log P_S - log P_T combined with clipped PPO/GRPO surrogate objective. Both teacher KL and RL optimization are load-bearing.
papers.notes: Reward is reverse-KL (student/teacher log-ratio) optimized via policy gradient, hybridizing KL distillation with RL surrogate.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L = E[sum_t min(rho_t * A_hat(i,t), clip(rho_t, 1-eps, 1+eps) * A_hat(i,t))] where r(i,t) = log P_S(y_t|x,y<t) - log P_T(y_t|x,c_safe,y<t)

papers.title: Filter, Then Reweight: Rethinking Optimization Granularity in On-Policy Distillation
papers.evidence: PPO-clipped surrogate loss with teacher-derived weighted advantages; no explicit KL divergence term between teacher and student distributions.
papers.notes: Teacher signal enters only through filtering and reweighting advantages, not as a KL distillation term. Bespoke RL-based distillation.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L_FiRe-OPD = -1/T sum_t min(r_t * a_tilde_t, clip(r_t, 1-eps, 1+eps) * a_tilde_t) where a_tilde_t = w_t / (1/T sum w_t') * a_t

papers.title: SafeSteer: Localized On-Policy Distillation for Efficient Safety Alignment
papers.evidence: Loss is Σ p_s(v) log(p_s(v)/p_t(v)), which is D_KL(student || teacher), i.e., reverse KL.
papers.notes: Localized to safety token subset S; teacher is activation-steered version of same model.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L(θ_s) = E_{b,m} [1/T_{b,m} Σ_t Σ_{v∈S} p_s(v) log(p_s(v)/p_t(v))]

papers.title: COMAP: Co-Evolving World Models and Agent Policies for LLM Agents
papers.evidence: Loss is NLL on environment next-state prediction plus EMA self-distillation and BCE/NLL policy terms, no explicit KL divergence to teacher distribution.
papers.notes: EMA self-distillation (L_WMSD) likely NLL-based soft-target matching but not explicitly KL; bespoke multi-component loss.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L_WM = E[-log p_S(s^env_{t+1}|s_t,a_t) + η L_WMSD]; L_policy = L^exp + L^ref + α E[-log p_θ(a^tgt|x^ref)] + β E[BCE(p_t, y^ref_t)]

papers.title: OmniOPD: Logit-Free On-Policy Distillation via Speculative Verification
papers.evidence: Loss is weighted NLL on teacher-scored chunks (semantic similarity scores as weights), not a KL divergence between teacher/student distributions.

papers.loss_formulation_latex: L = -sum_c [pi_hat_teacher^(c) * sum_{t in c} log pi_theta(y_t|x,y_{<t})] + beta * sum_{t in U} D_KL(pi_ref || pi_theta)

papers.title: Trust Region On-Policy Distillation

papers.notes: Bidirectional KL: RKL dominates trust region, FKL handles outliers and off-policy guidance.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: J_TrOPD = -I[x~π_S] M_x Σ π_T,v log(π_T,v/π_S,v) - I[x~π_S] M̄_x log(π_S/π_T) - β I[x~π_T] log(π_T/π_S)

papers.title: OPD+: Rethinking the Advantage Design for On-Policy Distillation
papers.evidence: Loss uses general f-divergence framework with w_f(u) = -f(u) + u*f'(u), generalizing beyond KL to arbitrary f-divergences.
papers.notes: Paper frames OPD under general f-divergence; KL is a special case but the contribution is the general f-divergence formulation.
papers.loss_formulation_latex: L = -E_{y~p_θ} Σ ∇_θ log p_θ(y_n|y_{<n},x) * w_f(u_{θ,n}) where w_f(u) = -f(u) + u*f'(u)

papers.title: Decomposed On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Reasoning: Steering Gradients for Visual Grounding

papers.title: Weak Critics Make Strong Learners: On-Policy Critique Distillation for Scalable Oversight

papers.title: Bridging Reasoning Trajectories in On-Policy Distillation via Near-Future Guidance
papers.evidence: L_OPD is reverse-KL on student rollouts (on-policy distillation). L_traj adds KL from teacher trajectories but supplements the dominant RKL objective.

papers.title: RAFT: Data Refinement and Adaptive Distillation for Domain Fine-Tuning with Alleviated Forgetting

papers.title: Are Full Rollouts Necessary for On-Policy Distillation?

papers.title: Your Teacher Can't Help You Here: Combating Supervision Fidelity Decay in On-Policy Distillation

papers.title: Prefix Teach, Suffix Fade: Local Teachability Collapse in Strong-to-Weak On-Policy Distillation

papers.title: Scaling Reasoning Efficiently via Relaxed On-Policy Distillation

papers.title: OpenClaw-RL: Train Any Agent Simply by Talking
papers.evidence: A_t = w_binary * r_final + w_opd*(log π_teacher - log π_old) combines RL reward with teacher-distillation signal in PPO surrogate.

papers.title: Entropy-Aware On-Policy Distillation of Language Models
papers.evidence: Loss combines PPO-clip reverse KL (low-entropy tokens) and top-k truncated forward KL (high-entropy tokens), both teacher-directed and load-bearing.

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Compression

papers.title: GATES: Self-Distillation under Privileged Context with Consensus Gating

papers.title: Fast and Effective On-policy Distillation from Reasoning Prefixes

papers.title: X-KD: General Experiential Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models

papers.title: On-Policy Context Distillation for Language Models
papers.evidence: Loss is D_KL(π_θ(·|x,y_{<t}) || π_teacher(·|c,x,y_{<t})), student in first argument = reverse KL.

papers.evidence: Loss combines λ·log(π*/π_ref) as reward signal with D_KL(π_θ||π_ref) regularizer; teacher π* provides token-level reward, KL regularizes student.

papers.title: Privileged Information Distillation for Language Models

papers.title: Video-OPD: Efficient Post-Training of Multimodal Large Language Models for Temporal Video Grounding via On-Policy Distillation

papers.title: Expanding the Capabilities of Reinforcement Learning via Text Feedback

papers.title: KEPO: Knowledge-Enhanced Preference Optimization for Reinforcement Learning with Reasoning

papers.title: From Correction to Mastery: Reinforced Distillation of Large Language Model Agents
papers.evidence: Primary objectives are NLL on teacher trajectories (L_BC) and GRPO with key-step/final rewards. No KL divergence to teacher distribution.

papers.title: RLKD: Distilling LLMs' Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence: GRPO with reward signals (R_acc, R_gsrm, R_format, R_tag); no explicit KL divergence to teacher distribution in the loss.
